cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. One lift, then. And tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds. Three if you say we're still friends when you hand it over.

mechanism: A treats lending equipment and reassurance of friendship as negotiable terms, correcting B casual offers into an exact exchange.
confusable: A normal rental quote exchanges money only; A must bargain over favors and emotional reassurance as equivalent items.
comparison: Birthday alternative prices forgiveness in family time, while ladder alternative negotiates a practical loan into reassurance.
seedUse: Ladder, lifts, five-minute need and friendship price derive from D22-a; S03 adds precise distinction between loan duration and requested return.
